events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in the oil market and global stock markets. The situation is being closely monitored by investors and geopolitical analysts.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to a surge in oil prices, which would negatively impact the oil and gas exploration and production sector. On the other hand, the S&P 500 could see a boost as investors seek safe-haven assets.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates
